title: Every 2026 radiosonde sounding of IGRA 2 (NOAA NCEI, ~800 stations, twice daily): the refraction coefficient k of the measured air, day and night

radius_enters_via.how: k = R/ρ is the ray's curvature divided by the Earth's: the radius is its unit (503 = R · 78.8e-6)

verdict_rule: Air in which k ≥ 1 (a ray curving as much as the ground, the globe looking flat) in most soundings, in every climate, by day and by night.

sources.cite: I. Durre, X. Yin, R. S. Vose, S. Applequist and J. Arnfield, Enhancing the Data Coverage in the Integrated Global Radiosonde Archive, J. Atmos. Oceanic Technol. 35 (2018) 1753-1770; IGRA version 2, NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

inputs.origin: NOAA NCEI, IGRA 2 current-year file of each station (data-y2d), downloaded once (fog fetch ref-igra).

notes: fog fetch ref-igra downloads the current-year files once (data-y2d, ~500 MB); the lock freezes them as collected. Method and references: go doc -all ./internal/build/igra.
